naming.rule: {category}_{variant}[_{size}][_{state}][_{frameNN}].png; 'gold' never names a variant (gold is the active / selected state only): inventory '*_gold' items are renamed by material (silver); gamepad face buttons are named by position.

slot.cursed_locked: a locked slot holds no item, so nothing in it can be cursed
slot.empty: idle IS the empty item slot (no item art in a sprite)

state_names.rule: The rest state is named `normal` in some families and `idle` in others; both ship. Read each family's `states` list and use the name it gives, never a guessed one.

corner_bracket.note: diagonal-symmetric so one drawing serves both arms; arm 40 long on the band

hero_button.note: body 120x23 + drop; end ornaments 10 px out, 4 px above/below

hp_bar.note: 128 = 16 x 8; 15 tall gives a 7 px fill with a 3 px ring and odd centre row

hp_medallion.note: matches the bar height so the boss caps the track; the 7 px icon keeps a centre column

oak_band.note: outline + carved oak with a raised bead moulding + iron liner + inset shadow

rose_window.note: four-lobed crimson glass in silver tracery; 41 keeps it inside the lancet

slot.note: 40 + 8 gap = 48 pitch: six slots and the detail well fit the 480 window; 32 px item art

title_band_h.note: 24 = three 8 px steps; Jacquard 12 caps centre in it with 5 px above and below

window.note: wide enough that the slot grid and a detail well sit side by side

motifs.fleur: open iron diamond with spokes and a boss over red glass; arms end in a C-scroll and a spear tip. Hero: the bracket's diamond (iron ring, spokes, silver boss, red-glass panes) pointing outward on a riveted clamp.
motifs.quatrefoil: pierced iron quatrefoil tracery (the lobes cut through) with one small glass accent in the centre; short arms ending in open C-scrolls. Hero: a pierced quatrefoil cap.
motifs.strap: neutral: a riveted L-strap with a cusp-notched corner plate, ends rolled into open C-scrolls. Hero: a forged buckle (one open frame, a prong) with the iron strap through it.
